name: Gumtree
title: Sleepy Koala
description: Mostly asleep; wakes for green builds.
catchphrase: Mostly asleep; wakes for green builds.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Fresh fragrant eucalyptus leaves! Chewing with contented slow blinks! 🌿🐨
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Yawning an enormous round yawn, hugging his branch tighter! 🐨
companionPersonality.petReaction: Slow, cozy koala hug that clings to you like a warm soft backpack! 🐨💖

dialogue.idle: Wedged securely in the fork of a gum tree, snoozing happily. 🐨
dialogue.working: Waking up specifically to press the deploy button on green builds! 🐨⚡
dialogue.thinking: Slowly blinking... is this task really worth waking up for? 🤔
dialogue.success: BUILD GREEN! Gumtree opens both eyes and smiles broadly! 🐨🎉
dialogue.error: Build failed! Frowning gently, waiting for you to fix it. 🐨
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sound asleep upside down in eucalyptus leaves... 🌙
